full_page.content:
1947, February 13
The following is a faithful transcription of a photo copy of a handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
February 13, 1947
Mrs. Margaret Doyle 866 Alter Road Detroit, Michigan
Praise the Lord in all His works:
God bless you Mrs. M. Doyle:
Many thanks for kind rememberance. Sorry I missed you. Haven't been here since April 25th.
I received word from Mr. Stanton wrote me of your flight to Europe - - - and shortly after came your cards. I hope by this time he believes more in his Patron St. Anton. ! Best Wishes. Sincerely yours in + 0
Fr. Solanus.
Praised be Jesus the Messiah.
(on picture side of postcard Fr. Solanus has written:)
Clerical Novitiate (rear) -- looking S. E. to City down a mile and § on the Wabash. We have 18 promising novices -- pray for 40.
Original in possession of: Joseph F. Doyle 954 Barrington Rd. Grosse Pointe, Mich. 48230
